newsitem.title: JAPAN: Comson shares ask-only on trouble in fund raising.
newsitem.headline: Comson shares ask-only on trouble in fund raising.

text.p: Shares of machinery company Comson Corp were ask-only on the Osaka Securities Exchange in early Thursday morning trade after its president said on Wednesday that the company was facing difficulties in raising funds to cover promissory notes.
At 0027 GMT, Comson shares were ask-only at 54 yen against Wednesday's close of 59 yen.
Comson president Toshimi Matsuda told a news conference on Wednesday that the company was having trouble raising 100 million yen to cover promissory notes due on Thursday.
Comson has a total of 300 million yen worth of promissory notes due on Thursday, he said.
